name: Toku
source: Toku (surname) is the lead analyst at the company, and the supervisor of the Risk Department. Formerly an intern, he quickly rose up the ranks due to his work ethics and expertise. Despite being easy to work with, he is completely obsessed with being the best at work, which causes friction with Nanako, and distances his friends and colleagues from him.
